subject: general
question: O is the centre of a circle of radius 10 cm. P is a point outside the circle and PQ is a tangent to the circle. What is the length (in cm) of PQ if the length OP is 26 cm?
solution:
**Given:**

O is the centre of a circle of radius 10 cm.

P is a point outside the circle and PQ is a tangent to the circle.

**Formula used:**

Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c1a597da7590321ee0a0835bc6978ea69d2aed3ec1d637e612756db34af1d738.png] 

According to the Question,

PQ² = OP² - OQ²

⇒ PQ² = 26² - 10²

⇒ PQ² = 676 - 100

⇒ PQ² = 576

⇒ PQ = 24 cm

**∴ The length (in cm) of PQ is 24 cm.**
